messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — during the midnight demo window I saw a spike of fairshare reclaims in uk-west; a bunch of small tenants lost 1-2 A100s each around 00:15 UTC. Did we run a reclaim job or was this vendor-preemptions? Trying to decide if we need a short-term borrow.
Kevin: I saw the alerts too. My first pass looks like our reclaim scheduler kicked in (we lowered softquota for some tenants last week). Will check reclaim logs now. :eyes:
Kevin: snippet from reclaim logs: ```reclaim.run id=slot-reclaim-v3 start=2025-11-12T00:14:58Z tenant=demo-*/demo-x reclaimed=1-2 gpus reason=fairshare-threshold```
Ash: @Marta can you paste which demo tenants were impacted? I want to map to the billing tags before opening any finance borrow.
Marta: demo-alpha, demo-gamma, demo-sprint3 — all small sandboxes used for interactive sessions. Impact lasted ~6-8m, users reported timeouts.
vendor-liaison: fyi vendor telemetry shows short preemption bursts in uk-west at 00:15-00:18 UTC but their scale-down events coincide with our reclaim window. They're investigating whether their spot allocator changed evict policy. I've opened vendor ticket VND-8742.
ops-bot: Scheduled job notice: reclaim-scheduler-v3 ran at 2025-11-12T00:14:50Z (trigger=fairshare-scan). Next run scheduled 2025-11-12T01:15:00Z.
Kevin: Ok — looks like a combination: our reclaim did run and vendor preemption amplified the effect. For short term we can: 1) pause reclaim for tenants with active demo tags, 2) request vendor soft hold for the next 2 hours, or 3) borrow 4 A100s for demo window. Which should we do?
Ash: I'd pause reclaim for demo-alpha/gamma/sprint3 for the next 24h and open a borrow for 4 A100s as a safety net. I'll tag finance.
Marta: +1 to pause reclaim, please also add a canary rule so we don't accidentally pause too widely. I'll notify product owners of the transient timeouts. :thumbsup:
vendor-liaison: Vendor acknowledged VND-8742 and put a 30m soft hold on preemptions for affected hosts; will update if they need capacity changes.
Kevin: I'll submit a tiny PR to disable reclaim for the three tenants (terraform snippet below) and post link when ready: ```resource "reclaim_pause" "demo_hold" { tenants = ["demo-alpha","demo-gamma","demo-sprint3"] until = "2025-11-13T00:15:00Z" }```
Ash: tagging #finance: @finance please approve short-term borrow of 4 A100s for demo window (cost center: ENG-DEMO).
Marta: Thanks all — action items: Kevin PR to pause reclaim (in flight), Ash to open borrow + finance ping, vendor-liaison monitoring VND-8742. Will follow up after vendor update.
